# SpeakAlert

SpeakAlert is an offline-first Android voice reminder app and voice alarm.

## Primary page
- https://ghostgramlabs.github.io/SpeakAlert/

## Additional pages
- https://ghostgramlabs.github.io/SpeakAlert/faq.html
- https://ghostgramlabs.github.io/SpeakAlert/privacy.html

## Install
- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ghostgramlabs.speakalert

## Summary
- Voice reminders with recorded voice
- Talking reminders with text-to-speech
- Voice alarm and talking alarm style alerts
- One-time and recurring reminders
- Daily, weekly, monthly, and custom schedules
- Repeat until dismissed behavior
- Tone-only mode
- Quiet hours
- Smart snooze
- Missed reminder tracking
- Fully offline use
- Private on-device storage
- No ads and no subscriptions
